committee: * Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 441-38 (COR) -Office of Legislative Secretary Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 441-38 (COR), which recognizes the Honorable Brian Jess Terlaje, Mayor of Yona, Yona Mayor’s Office staff, Yona Municipal Planning Council members, and Festival Committee members for their leadership, contributions, and support toward the planning, organization, and success of the 2nd Annual Cultural Festival by the Sea. The presentation is scheduled for Friday, August 28, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. at Majestic Tagåchang Beach in Yona.
